crossRefs.note: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel for twelve years. He reigned six years…
Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, struck Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, killed him…
